content.value_statement: Portfolio research can become fragmented across profiles, theses, themes, watchlists, and alerts. This skill routes each request into a structured workflow powered by LLMQuant Data.
actual_capabilities: Routes requests to documented company profile, thesis, theme, watchlist, and alert workflows.
Builds company profiles with fundamentals, valuation history, filings, events, red flags, and refresh status.
Converts investment logic into monitored theses with explicit sell conditions and evidence checks.
Creates and monitors thematic equity baskets using tickers, keywords, performance, valuation, and event signals.
Manages watchlists and measurable alerts for prices, implied volatility, events, activity, and thesis conditions.
limitations: Requires LLMQuant Data capabilities for current market data, filings, storage, alerts, and event monitoring.
Does not provide investment advice or guarantee the accuracy of external market data.
Cannot create sourced company facts when required data or filing evidence is unavailable.
Storage changes require clear user intent, and unsupported triggers remain unconfigured.

use_cases.title: Maintain Research Profiles
use_cases.description: Refresh company profiles with current fundamentals, valuation context, filings, events, red flags, and missing-data notices.

use_cases.title: Monitor Investment Theses
use_cases.description: Turn a position thesis into explicit buy logic, sell conditions, evidence checks, status updates, and action history.

use_cases.title: Track Themes and Watchlists
use_cases.description: Organize thematic baskets and watchlists, then surface performance changes, event signals, volatility extremes, and priority alerts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Company Profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a research profile for [ticker]. Retrieve current company data and filings, summarize fundamentals, valuation, events, red flags, and data gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Structure an Investment Thesis
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this investment thesis for [ticker] into monitored buy logic and explicit sell conditions. Check current evidence and mark unknown conditions clearly.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Market Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a provisional [theme] basket using these tickers and keywords: [inputs]. Compare performance, valuation, quality, concentration, and recent dated events.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a Priority Alert
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a measurable alert for [symbol] when [metric] [operator] [threshold], with [cadence] recurrence and [expiration]. Validate the current value first.

output_examples.input: Refresh the profile for ACME and show the latest risks.
output_examples.output: Profile Summary: ACME, technology sector, latest market snapshot and refresh date. Red Flags: elevated leverage, dated filing evidence, and unresolved event data. Valuation Band: partial historical comparison because coverage is incomplete.

output_examples.input: Track my thesis for ACME with a 25 percent price decline as a sell condition.
output: Sell Condition: sell if price declines 25 percent from the selected reference price.
Current Check: unknown until current market data and the reference price are available.

output_examples.input: Monitor my AI infrastructure theme and highlight urgent changes.
output_examples.output: Theme Snapshot: tracked tickers, keywords, update date, and concentration. Priority Alerts: dated event matches, largest movers, valuation outliers, stale tickers, and overlapping exposure.

best_practices: Name the portfolio object clearly, such as a company profile, thesis, theme, watchlist, or alert.
Provide tickers, thresholds, reference dates, and desired actions when requesting monitoring.
Review evidence dates, stale notices, missing data, and unknown trigger states before acting.
anti_patterns: Do not request profile facts without an available LLMQuant Data source.
Do not use vague alerts without a measurable metric, operator, threshold, cadence, and expiration.
Do not treat watchlist notifications or theme summaries as automatic trade recommendations.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It routes work for company profiles, investment theses, thematic baskets, watchlists, and measurable market alerts.

faq.question: Which data source does it use?
faq.answer: It prefers LLMQuant Data for portfolio storage, market snapshots, fundamentals, filings, events, valuation, options, and alerts.

faq.question: Can it create investment recommendations?
faq.answer: No. It organizes evidence, monitoring conditions, and research context without presenting an automatic trade recommendation.

faq.question: What happens when data is missing?
faq.answer: The workflow labels missing or stale evidence and marks unevaluable conditions as unknown rather than treating them as passing.

faq.question: Can it update my watchlist or alerts?
faq.answer: Yes, when you clearly request the change. It does not add or remove tickers or mutate alerts silently.

faq.question: What if LLMQuant Data is unavailable?
faq.answer: It can produce a structured profile, thesis, watchlist, or alert specification ready for later ingestion.
